Each module defines its own route method in GameActivity via UPL: TapCore: routeToTapCore(String requestJson, EngineBridgeCallback callback) TapLogin: routeToTapLogin(String requestJson, EngineBridgeCallback callback) TapCompliance: routeToTapCompliance(String requestJson, EngineBridgeCallback callback)
C++ JNI signature: (Ljava/lang/String;Lcom/taptap/sdk/kit/internal/enginebridge/EngineBridgeCallback;)Ljava/lang/String;
Sync: routeToTapCore("{\"method\":\"init\",...}", null) Async: routeToTapCore("{\"method\":\"getVersion\",...}", callbackObject)
EngineBridgeCallback: interface with onResult(String jsonString) -->
